# FlopRest v0.6.1 - Table of Contents

Parse Stripe-style REST API query params into Flop format for filtering, sorting, and pagination

## Pages

- [🔄 FlopRest](https://flop-rest.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://flop-rest.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [FlopRest](https://flop-rest.hexdocs.pm/FlopRest.md): Bidirectional transformation between Stripe-style REST query params and Flop format.
- [FlopRest.Filters](https://flop-rest.hexdocs.pm/FlopRest.Filters.md): Extracts and transforms REST-style filter params to Flop format and vice versa.

- [FlopRest.Operators](https://flop-rest.hexdocs.pm/FlopRest.Operators.md): Maps REST-style operator strings to Flop operator strings.
- [FlopRest.Pagination](https://flop-rest.hexdocs.pm/FlopRest.Pagination.md): Transforms REST-style pagination params to Flop format and vice versa.
- [FlopRest.Sorting](https://flop-rest.hexdocs.pm/FlopRest.Sorting.md): Parses REST-style sort strings into Flop format and vice versa.
